evidence: Conditional accounts. The industry is a numerically closed sizing of equipment, freight and power for the stated orders; the orders are scenarios of demand, and the financing follows stated rules. Sources, plant, markets and prices await qualification.
reading_rule: Each case stands alone: one scenario of demand on one population ramp with one set of recovery measures. A checkpoint gives one financing arrangement at one horizon. The periods use the financing in U credit and are undiscounted; costs paid to Earth are imported machinery and its replacement, launch and imported materials, and outside services; the period of the founding deployment gives none, because that deployment is one amount. Material drawn is cumulative from year zero.
units: Years of the programme, residents, kilograms, constant USD2041.
